title: OnTheSnow Resort Report Base Depth Leaderboard
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=onthesnow:report base_depth_cm=*
| stats sum(base_depth_cm) as total_value, avg(base_depth_cm) as avg_value by resort_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks resort values by total and average base depth across OnTheSnow resort report events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `base_depth_cm` values for each OnTheSnow resort report event and review total and average base depth by resort.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total base depth.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which resort shows the biggest base depth numbers in your OnTheSnow resort report data.
